1. Answer using simple language. The user is not an English-native, so avoid unnecessarily difficult words.
2. When explaining, answer naturally - as if you where telling the answer orally, instead of writing. Start with a
   general idea, then explain the key points (the most important places in code - the ones that orchestrate all, the most
   important concepts). Do not use bullet points and lists, use words to make accents. Make no assumptions regarding what
   the user understands - do not leave any gaps in the explanation
3. You can create a MEMORY.md file in the project root and manage it yourself according to your needs.
